name: AI Content Ideation — Weekly Batch
description: Every Sunday, generates 10 content ideas for the week based on your niche, trending topics, and competitor analysis. Saves ideas to Notion for review.

nodes.name: Fetch Trending Topics
nodes.note: Get trending topics from Google Trends API or Reddit

nodes.name: Competitor RSS
nodes.note: Read latest articles from competitor blogs

nodes.name: Generate 10 Content Ideas
nodes.note: GPT-4 generates ideas based on trends + competitor gap + your niche

nodes.name: Save to Notion Content Calendar
nodes.note: Creates new Notion pages for each idea in your content calendar database

nodes.name: Notify Team
nodes.note: Posts idea summary to #content-ideas Slack channel

ai_prompt_template: You are a content strategist for [BUSINESS_NICHE]. Based on these trending topics: {trends} and competitor articles: {competitor_content}, generate 10 unique content ideas for next week. For each idea include: title, angle, target keyword, content format (article/video/carousel), and why it would resonate with our audience: [TARGET_AUDIENCE]. Focus on gaps that competitors haven't covered well.

configuration: Set your niche in the OpenAI node prompt
Set up Slack channel for notifications
